title: Configuration with a written segment
statement: Let a Turing machine configuration have $k$ work tapes, symbol alphabet $\mathrm{Symbol}$, state set $S$, and fixed input $x$. Given a tape index $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(k)$, a finite word $w$ over $\mathrm{Symbol}$, a configuration $d$, a state $q\in S$, an input-head position $p\in\mathrm{Fin}(|x|+2)$, and a length $r\in\mathbb N$, define a new configuration with state $q$ and input-head position $p$. On tape $i$, replace the cells from the old head position $d_i$ through $d_i+r-1$ by the buffer contents of $w$ at offsets from $0$ through $r-1$, leave all other tape cells unchanged, and move that tape's head right by $r$; every other tape and the output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: finite word $w$ over the symbol alphabet
